verification: All nine ROMs match their pinned official ZIP entries (checked 2026-11-20)
target: DMG current skipped-boot model; HALT, EI/DI and interrupt-entry timing, some synchronised on VBlank through the provisional PPU
components: Inherit official prebuilt WLA-DX workflow, MIT notice and separate Darkrose font provenance/limits from the shared manifest; no independently reproduced build or binary redistribution
reporting: Audited bodies write no SB/SC and use no DMA; all report through common quit. Require the first packet and B/C/D/E/H/L signature. All nine are DMG-verified in their source headers.
limits_review: Bounded delay loops, HALT waits and VBlank waits; all below one silent LY-wait timeout (851968 M-cycles). Existing 1000000 M-cycle and 10 host-second caps are kept.
added_by: #79: halt_ime1_timing2-GS and di_timing-GS failed before the fix; halt_ime0_nointr_timing passed only through cancelling errors. The other six are controls.
